mapper.sql: select transaction_id, request_no, business_type, business_id, institution_id, mer_id, bank_code, channel_type, amount, status, bank_serial_no, pay_url, response_code, response_message, complete_time, create_time, update_time, bank_time, environment, snapshot_json, attempt_no, bank_status, booking_status, next_query_time, query_count, manual_review, return_time, return_reason from bank_transaction
mapper.select: where business_type = #{businessType} and business_id = #{businessId} order by attempt_no desc limit 1
mapper.update: update bank_transaction set status = 'SUCCESS', bank_status = 'SUCCESS', booking_status = 'DONE', next_query_time = null, manual_review = 0, bank_serial_no = #{bankSerialNo}, response_code = #{responseCode}, response_message = #{responseMessage}, complete_time = #{completeTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} where transaction_id = #{transactionId} and status in ('PENDING','UNKNOWN')
